verdict.rationale: GitHub documents natural-language operation through Copilot. Users send plain-English prompts in Agent mode, and Copilot analyzes the codebase and generates edits (github-docs-13). Users can explore repos, plan changes and delegate coding tasks on GitHub.com in natural language (github-docs-73, github-docs-97), and the cloud agent turns an issue into a pull request (github-docs-61). The GitHub MCP server lets Copilot Chat act on repositories, issues and pull requests (github-docs-29), and the Copilot CLI brings this to the terminal (github-docs-23). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language control, and explicit evidence that natural-language commands cover platform administration such as settings, Actions and org management beyond code, issues and PRs.
